metadata.description: CGraph: a native code graph and change-context engine for coding agents.

plugins.name: cgraph
plugins.description: MCP graph tools (query, context, impact and status by default; explain, path, report and more with CGRAPH_MCP_TOOLS=all), the cgraph and cgraph-enrich skills, and a pre-edit hook that names the files most likely to change with an edit and the services on the far side of the endpoints a file serves or calls.
